sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "riskmanagement"."flowlink" AS e, AVG("riskmanagement"."compscore") AS m1, AVG(("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess")) AS m2, (AVG("riskmanagement"."compscore") - AVG(("riskmanagement"."ctrleff" - "riskmanagement"."riskassess"))) AS m3 FROM "riskmanagement" GROUP BY "riskmanagement"."flowlink") SELECT AVG("s1"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s1"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s1"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s1"
quantities: riskmanagement.control effectiveness score minus risk score
why: average of compliance posture score per dataflow (by flowlink)
control effectiveness score - risk score: both in points and of the same kind (stocks) on the same risk management record

coarsen to all: AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
